# Portals — 7-Day Women's Ayahuasca Retreat near Tulum, Mexico

> Portals is a women-only ceremonial retreat held in a private sanctuary in the Mayan jungle near Tulum, Quintana Roo, Mexico. The next retreat runs January 15–21, 2027. Website: https://portals.theheartbased.co/

Portals is not a medical or therapeutic service. It does not diagnose, treat or cure any condition. Participation requires a safety assessment, and some medications and health conditions are contraindicated.

## The retreat

- 7 days and 6 nights, women only, intentionally small circles for personal care.
- Next dates: January 15–21, 2027, near Tulum, Mexico.
- One Ayahuasca ceremony across the week, held by an experienced ceremonialist and a woman shaman.
- The facilitating team has guided 400+ ceremonies.
- Also included: sound healing and sound baths, temazcal, cacao ceremony, yoga, ecstatic dance, art-making and creative release, vocal activation workshops, a workbook.
- Healthy, conscious meals throughout, with vegan, gluten-free and dairy-free options.
- Private on-site pool and communal rooftop.
- Retreat workbook.
- One pre-retreat group preparation call.
- One post-retreat group integration call.
- A personal photoshoot included to mark the participants chapter
- Facilitating team emphasizes on personal care and holds the group with reverence and integrity.

## Pricing

- From 2,350 USD per person (early-bird), reduced from 2,650 USD. 
- Room options: The Serenity Suite (private room, private bathroom); The Hearts Haven (shared with 1 woman, own bed, shared bathroom); The Trinity (shared with 2 women, own bed, shared bathroom).
- All room options include the full retreat program and meals.
- Flexible payment options are available.
- Joining the waitlist gives early-bird pricing, the full brochure, and first choice of room.

## Safety and suitability

- Every participant completes a safety assessment before joining.
- Medication contraindications are reviewed together.
- Conditions that are not generally recommended include: antidepressants (such as SSRIs or MAOIs) or antipsychotic medications; psychiatric conditions or family histories of certain mental health disorders; surgery within the past three months; heart conditions; uncontrolled high blood pressure; uncontrolled diabetes; epilepsy; active addiction; pregnancy.
- If any of these apply, participation may still be possible — it is assessed case by case.
- First-time participants are common and welcome. A preparation guide is provided.
- No participant is pressured into any activity. Group agreements are set so everyone feels supported.

## After the retreat

- Women who attend are added to a WhatsApp group to stay in touch
- A post-retreat group integration call is included.
- Many participants stay in touch and meet up in other cities.
